full_page.content:
Page 171 Cont.
Nov. 29 Francis S. Koltz - 87 - Sight failing - last of a double family - holding his job for over 25 years (office in Elm-wood Cemetry - Says his rosary but finds difficulty lately in reading his prayer- book
Clo Gardiner - 11 - shot in eye by "baby gun" threatened with loss of eye - Little sister was prayed for a year or so back - badly burned "hopeless" - is OK now - Except scarred limbs.
Richard J. Shields - 54 - Lutheran - wife Catholic (ought to be) fears operation on Eye - proposes to push ceremony of having his marriage blest if spared operation
Leonard Mckinley - 16 - Lukemia and Hodgkins - Drs. hopeless .... "seems improving.
Novena
1939, December
Page 172 Dec. 1st Mrs. M. Bisesi - 61 - Asthma, stomach, etc.
Wm. J. Storen - 67 - had operation 8 weeks ago - cancerous obstruc- tion of bowels.
3 Fred Grablowski - 33 - internal cancer .... 3 months to live. Charles E. Barkley & wife - married 33 years - reconciliation ....
4 Geo. Wilson - 12 - Spinal maningitis since last Friday - in Kiefer Hosp. enrolled This P.M.
Mrs. Mary Paddock - 64 - Cheboygan - internal cancer - given up by Drs .... Husband unbeliever - Strange, however, has encouraged the sons & daughters to go to Church - was quite upset when children married, as one or two of them did, out of the Church. The Mrs. enrolled To-day.
5 Stanley Sikorski - 72 - of Cheboygan - away from Church and Sacra- ments for 35 yrs. Though seemingly a charitable heart for poor.
Gert. Clinton - about 35, attorney
Ralph Vagnier - 40 - in bad - con.
